description: Fixed 20-task coding suite for the local-model harness-gain metric. Same MLX checkpoint, three harnesses (fusion-code, opencode, goose). Every task is file-based and verified deterministically by an expected predicate, no LLM judging.

model.rule: one checkpoint per full suite run; record exact build id in results

protocol.isolation: fresh temp git repo per task per harness
protocol.prompt: single-turn user prompt from task.prompt; no extra hints
protocol.tokenSource: harness-reported usage; fusion-code also cross-checked from session jsonl

tasks.prompt: In config.ini the value of retries is 3. Change it to 5.
Create a file named hello.py containing a main function that prints the string 'hello harness'.
app.py raises NameError when run. Fix it so running `python3 app.py` prints 42.
Rename the function `calc` to `calculate` in utils.py and update the caller in main.py.
Add a function `moving_average(xs, k)` to stats.py that returns the list of k-window moving averages, and export it in __init__.py.
tests/test_cart.py::test_total fails. Fix cart.py so the test passes without modifying the test.
Implement a ` LRUCache` class in lru.py with get/put in O(1).
Extract the duplicated validation logic in api.py (three near-identical if-blocks) into one helper function. Behavior must not change; tests must pass.
The JSON file data/settings.json has a syntax error. Fix it and set the value of "verbose" to true.
build.sh fails with 'bad interpreter' because of CRLF line endings. Fix the file so `bash build.sh` runs.
Somewhere in src/ the string TODO_FIX_ME appears. Replace it with the word DONE wherever it occurs.
Add CLI flag --dry-run to tool.py: when set, commands are printed instead of executed.
The retry loop in client.py retries forever on timeouts. Make it stop after 3 attempts and raise RetryError.
Implement merge sort in sort.py without using the built-in sort; include a doctest-runnable main.
Add a new module src/plugins/greeter.py following the exact pattern of src/plugins/welcomer.py, and register it in src/plugins/__init__.py.
parser.py mis-handles quoted CSV fields containing commas. Fix it; tests/test_parser.py must pass.
Write a function `diff_lines(a, b)` in difftool.py returning unified-diff-style output for two lists of strings.
models.py has a 120-line monolithic function `load_all`. Split it into at least three cohesive functions with the same external behavior; all tests must pass.
server.py has a race: two concurrent POSTs to /counter can lose an increment. Fix it with a lock so tests/test_server.py::test_concurrent_increments passes.
Upgrade the repo from config format A to B: convert legacy_config.yaml to app_config.toml (same values), make loader.py read the toml, and delete the yaml. Tests must pass.

fixtureRepo.description: One fixture git repo per task kind is generated by the runner (setup files + tests); fixture contents are versioned next to this file so every harness sees identical inputs.

openQuestions: T07 prompt has a stray space before LRUCache - clean up when authoring fixtures
goose recipe for headless run: `GOOSE_MODE=approve goose run --text -t <prompt>`; opencode: `opencode run <prompt>`; verify exact non-interactive flags at runner-authoring time
